property_summary: For any recipient and amount, sendMoney always succeeds regardless of how much gas the recipient's receive() consumes (low-level call forwards most gas), while the mutant's 2300-gas transfer fails—reverting sendMoney—once the recipient burns more than 2300 gas.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a plain transfer, changing gas forwarding and failure semantics (revert vs. ignored return).
